answer: A bond stake registry prices Sybil risk directly: each agent identity must post collateral scaling with the reputation it claims, so a hundred fresh keys cost a hundred deposits. Grading holds that stake idle and slashable while work is verified, turning cheap vote inflation into money at risk. A saffron dashboard tag changes nothing. Honest miners withdraw only after grading clears, so ferrous spammer accounts flooding threads earn no reward, just locked capital. A basalt slashing rule seizes stake from clusters voting in lockstep, pushing each sock account's cost past its expected payout.
